    G = Q(80)        # gross common equity
    intang = Q(22)   # intangibles, deducted in full
    dta = Q(29)      # deferred tax assets
    thr = Q("0.14")  # DTA threshold ratio on (gross equity - intangibles)
    rwa0 = Q(1600)
    exp0 = Q(2600)
    rwa_req = Q("0.075")
    lev_req = Q("0.03")
    rwa_add = Q("0.2")  # share of X added to RWA

    def dta_ded(X):
        return max(dta - thr * (G + X - intang), Q(0))

    def net_eq(X):
        return G + X - intang - dta_ded(X)

    # Before injection
    init_ded = dta_ded(Q(0))
    init_net = net_eq(Q(0))

    # X at which DTA deduction reaches zero
    X_kink = max((dta / thr) - (G - intang), Q(0))

    def min_X(req, base, add):
        # Constraint: net_eq(X) >= req*(base + add*X); net_eq is piecewise linear in X
        if net_eq(Q(0)) >= req * (base):
            return Q(0)
        # Region 1: deduction positive -> net = (G-intang)(1+thr) - dta + (1+thr)X
        a1 = (G - intang) * (1 + thr) - dta
        s1 = 1 + thr
        X1 = (req * base - a1) / (s1 - req * add)
        if X1 <= X_kink:
            return X1
        # Region 2: no deduction -> net = G - intang + X
        X2 = (req * base - (G - intang)) / (1 - req * add)
        return X2

    X_rwa = min_X(rwa_req, rwa0, rwa_add)
    X_lev = min_X(lev_req, exp0, Q(1))
    X = max(X_rwa, X_lev)

    if X == 0:
        binding = "none"
    elif X_rwa >= X_lev:
        binding = "rwa"
    else:
